blocks.text: (IN RUSSIAN)|ANNA? I'M HERE|FOR OUR FRIENDS|IN MOSCOW. MEET|ME THIS AFTERNOON,|AT THE CAFÉ.
AN ENVOY FROM THE RUSSIAN CONSULATE, AT YOUR SERVICE.
ARE YOU READY|FOR THE NEXT STEP?
TOMORROW, YOU WILL GIVE THIS PASSPORT TO A WOMAN. SHE WILL ASK YOU: “WEREN'T WE IN CALIFORNIA TOGETHER LAST SUMMER?” YOU WILL ANSWER: “NO, I THINK IT WAS IN THE HAMPTONS.”
BY TAKING THAT PASSPORT,|SHE HAS JUST CONFESSED.
ANNA CHAPMAN?|FBI. PLEASE COME WITH US.
